messageStackingTutorial.title: How message stacking works
messageStackingTutorial.description: Once enabled, Enter and the arrow keys behave differently in the chat input:
messageStackingTutorial.stepEnter: Enter: saves what you typed as a pending draft and clears the input
messageStackingTutorial.stepDoubleEnter: Press Enter again right away, on the now-empty input: sends that draft immediately
messageStackingTutorial.stepArrows: Up, with the caret at the very start of the input: browse the draft queue — keep pressing Up/Down to move, Enter to load the highlighted draft back into the input
messageStackingTutorial.stepEscape: Esc: stop browsing the queue and return to the input
